name: Vietnam

flag.description: A red field with a large yellow five-pointed star in the centre.
flag.symbolism: Red stands for revolution and the blood shed for independence; the five points of the star represent intellectuals, farmers, workers, businesspeople and soldiers.

hook: Vietnam is a single big yellow star in the centre of red; China moves its star to the corner and adds four small ones.
trivia: The flag was first used in 1940 in an uprising in southern Vietnam and became the flag of the reunified country in 1976.
Vietnam is one of the largest coffee producers in the world, second only to Brazil.
